gloss: garbage truck; collection vehicle; refuse truck

definitions.gloss: garbage truck; collection vehicle; refuse truck
definitions.explanation: a vehicle used to collect and transport waste, recyclables, or other materials

examples.english: I put out the trash before the garbage truck comes.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{収集|しゅうしゅう}→収集：11829_shuushuu⟧ (collection/gathering) and ⟦{車|しゃ}→車：09874_sha⟧ (vehicle). The full formal term is ⟦ゴミ→ゴミ：00840_gomi⟧{収集車|しゅうしゅうしゃ} (garbage collection vehicle). In daily conversation, people often say ⟦ゴミ→ゴミ：00840_gomi⟧⟦{収集|しゅうしゅう}→収集：11829_shuushuu⟧ (garbage collection) or simply refer to the truck coming. Japan has strict garbage separation rules, and knowing collection schedules and procedures is essential for daily life.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦ゴミ→ゴミ：00840_gomi⟧{収集車|しゅうしゅうしゃ}: garbage truck
- {収集車|しゅうしゅうしゃ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{来|く}る→来る：00254_kuru⟧: the collection truck comes
- {収集車|しゅうしゅうしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧: collection truck schedule
- ⟦{資源|しげん}→資源：03167_shigen⟧{収集車|しゅうしゅうしゃ}: recycling collection vehicle

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ゴミ→ゴミ：00840_gomi⟧⟦{収集|しゅうしゅう}→収集：11829_shuushuu⟧: garbage collection — the service itself, not the vehicle
- {清掃車|せいそうしゃ}: cleaning vehicle — broader term that can include street sweepers
- パッカー⟦{車|しゃ}→車：09874_sha⟧: compactor truck — technical term for the type of truck used
